name: of1-skills
description: Integrate OF1 (generative-search) into an existing Adobe Edge Delivery Services project: verify prerequisites, extract/reuse design tokens, generate templates and CTA config, style the generative block, and publish. Runs standalone against any EDS/Stardust repo — no demo-building or site-crawling steps.

_notes.entrypoints: of1-integration is the standalone entry point — invoke it directly against an existing EDS repo. It dispatches every other skill in this plugin per its own step graph (see of1-integration/SKILL.md). of1-check-dependencies is of1-integration's own step 1; it also supports a demo-track check (of1-demo-orchestrator/of1-discovery/of1-prototype/of1-snowflake) used only when invoked from the of1-demo-skills plugin in pipeline mode.
